atom_did IS NOT COUNTY-PREFIXED (P-193 CONFIRMED LIVE), BUT THE REAL SAFETY MECHANISM IS entity_id, NOT THE DID SCHEME. Sampled rows: `did:hauska:well-fact:48179:862:none` -- county fips is a middle segment, not a prefix. The unique constraint is `atoms_entity_composite_unique` on (entity_type, entity_id), and entity_id itself already embeds county fips ('48179:862:none'). So cross-farm merge collisions are avoided by DATA correctness (every writer must put the right county fips in entity_id), not by anything atom_did's shape does structurally -- a distinction the draft did not make and that matters for the merge-mechanics answer.
